datumesh.com/scripture/chapter_count: The number of chapters of a book of scripture: chapter_count(corpus, book), corpus lowercase tanakh, nt or quran, book an OSIS code (Gen, Ps, Matt, "1Cor") or Quran (its 114 surahs).
datumesh.com/scripture/edition: A source edition of a scripture text, edition(corpus, code). Codes are lowercase: edition(tanakh, uxlc), the Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex; edition(nt, sblgnt), the SBL Greek New Testament; edition(quran, uthmani) and edition(quran, simple), the Tanzil Quran Text. Its methods give the version, the source URL, the SHA-256 of the source file, the licence notice in full, and the source file itself where it may be redistributed.
datumesh.com/scripture/edition/file: The exact source file of a scripture edition, byte for byte as downloaded (sblgnt, uthmani and simple).
datumesh.com/scripture/edition/file_hash: The SHA-256 of the source file of a scripture edition, the file every verse was checked against before it was signed.
datumesh.com/scripture/edition/notice: The licence or copyright notice of a scripture edition in full, as its source gives it.
datumesh.com/scripture/edition/source_ur: The URL a scripture edition's source file was downloaded from.
datumesh.com/scripture/edition/version: The version of a scripture edition, as its source names it.
datumesh.com/scripture/verse: A verse of scripture in its original language: the Hebrew Bible (Tanakh: the Torah, the Prophets and the Writings) in Hebrew, the Greek New Testament and the Quran in Arabic. verse(corpus, book, chapter, verse). Corpus and edition codes are lowercase: corpus tanakh, nt or quran; edition uxlc (tanakh), sblgnt (nt), uthmani or simple (quran). book is an OSIS code, case as written (Gen, Ps, Matt, 1Cor), or Quran. For the Quran, chapter is the surah and verse the ayah: verse(quran, Quran, 2, 255).text(uthmani). A book code that starts with a digit is quoted in a call: verse(nt, "1Cor", 13, 4). Book codes, exact: tanakh: Gen Exod Lev Num Deut Josh Judg 1Sam 2Sam 1Kgs 2Kgs Isa Jer Ezek Hos Joel Amos Obad Jonah Mic Nah Hab Zeph Hag Zech Mal 1Chr 2Chr Ps Job Prov Ruth Song Eccl Lam Esth Dan Ezra Neh. nt: Matt Mark Luke John Acts Rom 1Cor 2Cor Gal Eph Phil Col 1Thess 2Thess 1Tim 2Tim Titus Phlm Heb Jas 1Pet 2Pet 1John 2John 3John Jude Rev. quran: Quran.
datumesh.com/scripture/verse/text: The exact text of a verse in one edition, a UTF-8 text blob, never normalised or changed. Edition codes are lowercase: uxlc (tanakh, Hebrew, the Unicode/XML Leningrad Codex), sblgnt (nt, Greek, the SBL Greek New Testament), uthmani or simple (quran, Arabic, the Tanzil Quran Text). Book codes, exact: tanakh: Gen Exod Lev Num Deut Josh Judg 1Sam 2Sam 1Kgs 2Kgs Isa Jer Ezek Hos Joel Amos Obad Jonah Mic Nah Hab Zeph Hag Zech Mal 1Chr 2Chr Ps Job Prov Ruth Song Eccl Lam Esth Dan Ezra Neh. nt: Matt Mark Luke John Acts Rom 1Cor 2Cor Gal Eph Phil Col 1Thess 2Thess 1Tim 2Tim Titus Phlm Heb Jas 1Pet 2Pet 1John 2John 3John Jude Rev. quran: Quran.
datumesh.com/scripture/verse_count: The number of verses in a chapter of scripture: verse_count(corpus, book, chapter), corpus lowercase tanakh, nt or quran, book an OSIS code (Gen, Ps, Matt, "1Cor") or Quran (the ayat of a surah).
